profile.headline: Software Developer at ServiceNow
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer at Service-Now working on our mobile platform as a part of the back end team. My job is to deploy enable our mobile client development through the development of fast and effective web service interfaces.

I have varying levels of familiarity with concepts and languages including Java, Javascript, C#, Oracle SQL, and Shell Scripting. Through my work with different software vendors I've become familiarized with ITSM and network monitoring applications like ServiceNow, xMatters, HP Service Manager, HP Service Anywhere, BMC Remedy, SolarWinds Orion, CA Service Desk, HPOM, Vmware Vcenter, and Lync.

I have a taste for entrepreneurship and helped start an amateur theatre in my community. I have a keen interest in working on fun new projects and finding ways to bring a technological perspective any table.

positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States

positions.title: Developer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
As a consultant at Techport I deploy enterprise notification software that works with management systems in IT departments. For some software this involves using a previously built integration coded in Java and Javascript and tailoring it based on client requirements. For less common monitoring software I build custom integrations that take advantage of existing notification or alerting functionality to inject the data into xMatters. 

I have built integrations of varying complexity for VSphere and Service Anywhere into xMatters, Bomgar into ServiceNow. I also built a proof of concept integration between ServiceNow and Lync for Office 365 (now Skype For Business) which allows users to IM messages directly from ServiceNow and automatically log the conversation in ServiceNow. This integration is targeted for potential release as a scoped application in the app store released in Fuji. These integrations primarily leverage Java, Javascript, and C#.

positions.title: Computer Technician
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Provide multiple levels of technical support for clients over the phone and in person. Translate computer related problems into language non-technical users are comfortable with and offer them service and product solutions. Perform a variety of tests in an organized and efficient way and multitask on ten to twenty computers while also upholding the greatest integrity concerning their privacy.

As a Geek Squad "Agent" I was tracked closely for customer satisfaction metrics as a key indicator of my success. During my tenure as a client facing agent I received multiple awards and incentives due to my excellent customer satisfaction surveys. Once I was promoted to an advanced repair agent where my contact with clients was reduced I worked with management to identify strategies to help us hold back office Geek Squad employees to the same high standards. I obtained multiple awards at that time as a result.

positions.title: Artistic Director
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Founded a community theatre company specializing in providing a creative outlet for young theatre producers, technicians and actors.

positions.title: Starbucks Barista Supervisor
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
The duties of Starbucks Supervisor involved managing a team of six to eight baristas serving a steady flow of customers at grocery stores within very different neighborhoods.

In addition to the regular duties including scheduling, training, and hiring I spent significant time overhauling the merchandising strategies for my kiosk according to the guidelines provided by my company and improved sales putting my department at the top of its revenue band.
